answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 6555 Country: IE Title: I was doing smoking. Now I am trying to stop smoking and getting medical treatment. My doctor gave me some patches to paste it on my arm all the time before sleep. So, during this patch having pasted at my arm, can i perform my namaz? Question: Assalamoalakom. I was doing smoking. Now I am trying to stop smoking and getting medical treatment. My doctor gave me some patches to paste it on my arm all the time before sleep. So, during this patch having pasted at my arm, can i perform my namaz? Answer ID: 6555 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 819/752=L/1429) If there is no impurity on that patch, then you can pray salah pasting the same on your arms. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
